title: Casa Cielo | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to "Casa Cielo," a refined coastal retreat. Tucked behind the private gates of Sunset Beach in Seacrest, this chic Gulf-front community offers an elevated yet effortlessly relaxed escape, where understated luxury meets the timeless beauty of 30A. From the moment you arrive, Casa Cielo invites you to slow down and settle in. Sun-washed interiors, airy living spaces, and thoughtfully curated coastal details create a calm, welcoming atmosphere designed for comfort and ease. Every element of the home reflects a laid-back elegance, making it the perfect backdrop for a restorative beachside stay. Step outside and discover just how special this location truly is. A short stroll leads you to the sugar-white sands of the Gulf via private, deeded beach access, while the beautifully maintained community pool offers a serene place to relax, complete with sweeping views of the coastline. Whether you’re soaking up the sun, enjoying an afternoon swim, or watching the sky change colors over the water, every moment here feels intentionally unhurried. Exploring the area is effortless. Enjoy four complimentary adult bikes for cruising the scenic 30A bike path or take an easy walk to Seacrest Village, home to locally loved dining, boutique shopping, and lively entertainment. From sunrise coffee runs to afternoons on the water and evenings filled with live music under the stars, everything that defines the 30A lifestyle is just minutes from your door. Casa Cielo offers a thoughtfully curated luxury experience in one of Seacrest’s most sought-after gated communities. Perfect for guests seeking refined comfort, coastal beauty, and unforgettable moments along the Gulf. **Pet Friendly (2 dog max up to 25lb. – $250/dog) HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Private Deeded Beach Access -Community Pool with Gulf Views -4 Adult Bikes -Smart TVs -Washer & Dryer -Fully Equipped Kitchen -Outdoor Patio with Dining and Sitting Areas -Large Balcony -Gas Grill -Beach Gear -2 Dedicated Parking Spots ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 7 2 Bedrooms / 3 Baths FIRST FLOOR: -Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom 1: King -Bedroom 2: Full with Twin Trundle, with Ensuite **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Two parking spaces available (2 driveway). Included are 4 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. SUNSET BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Villas of Sunset Beach is a gated community, located beachside on Highway 30A in Seacrest Beach, Florida. Driving down the palm tree-lined boulevard is only the beginning of a totally luxurious experience. Located between Rosemary and Alys Beaches and within walking distance to casual or fine dining. No dragging your beach gear across the street because the beautiful emerald waters of the gulf and the beachfront community pool are only steps away. Spacious gulf-front condominiums and elegant gulf-side homes make this community perfect for everyone. **Please Note:** *Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals. BEACH ACCESS Enjoy private deeded beach access just past the community pool. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Pet friendly- up to 2 dogs allowed up to 25lbs. Pet fee of $250/dog applies. Host must be notified of pet prior to arrival. 2 Dog Max! *Capacity for 2 vehicles in the driveway. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
